source: Set One: Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE-> Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony PCM-601ESD DIGITAL AUDIO PROCESSOR-> SP/DIF-> Mytek Stereo 192 Sample Rate Converter-> Upsampled to 44.1kHz/24bit-> SP/DIF-> RME FIREFACE 800-> FireWire 400-> Lenovo K450e Desktop PC-> WaveLab 6.11; Set Two: DAT-> PANASONIC SV-3700-> TASCAM DA-30 (Spring 1996)-> DAT-> Panasonic SV-3800-> SP/DIF-> RME FIREFACE 800-> FireWire 400-> Lenovo K450e Desktop PC-> Adobe Audition 3.0.1; Wavelab 7.1 mastering by Jamie Waddell; Track, FLAC and Pack by John Wenzel; a project **GEMS**

ai_review.summary: Exceptional soundboard recording of a legendary Fillmore show featuring guest appearances and pristine piano performance, delivering an amazing listening experience.
ai_review.review: The concert is hailed as one of the greatest shows ever captured, with flawless restoration that makes it sound astonishingly clear. Highlights include Nelson, Grisman and others joining the band, Phil Lesh adding electric bass to the acoustic set, and Jerry Garcia’s surprising piano work on “To Lay Me Down.” Reviewers unanimously praise both the musical performance and the pristine sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are five‑star, emphasizing an outstanding performance and a superbly cleaned‑up soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaned‑up master with crystal‑clear mix; reviewers describe the sound as beautiful, amazing, and peer‑less.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Memorable night with guest appearances (Nelson, Grisman), an acoustic set enhanced by Phil’s electric bass, and seamless transitions that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted playing piano on “To Lay Me Down,” adding a special touch to the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Added electric bass to the acoustic set, which reviewers highlighted as a unique moment.
